explanation: He copied a flowering plum garden and a bridge in a sudden shower, adding borders of Japanese characters. He and his brother Theo collected hundreds of Japanese prints in Paris.

claims.text: In 1887 Van Gogh painted oil copies of two prints by Utagawa Hiroshige: Plum Park in Kameido and Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge.
Van Gogh's 1887 copies of Japanese prints were not after Hokusai, Utamaro or Sharaku.
Van Gogh added borders of Japanese characters to his copies of the Hiroshige prints.
Van Gogh and his brother Theo collected hundreds of Japanese woodblock prints in Paris.
